_comment: The only hand-written file. `include` forces a project into a layer, `exclude` keeps one out, `packages` declares what a repository publishes so weekly installs can be read. Give every entry a reason: the pipeline reruns weekly and a reason is how the next person knows whether the correction still holds.

exclude.fastagent-sh/fastagent: ours; we measure the stack, we are not neutral about our own place in it
